description: In-game Wave Info panel readings from Tier 1 campaign runs, waves 1 to 2368, one reading per wave. Every value is what the panel displayed; nothing is derived.

provenance.source: Screenshots of the game's Wave Info panel, read by tooling/panel-capture/tower-panel-capture.swift (text recognition, each reading validated by format, chance total and repeated cells)
provenance.runs: Seven capture runs on one day. Where two runs recorded the same wave they showed the same chances and spawn rate; the later run's row is kept.

account.note: Same account as the Tier 7 fixture. Runs with and without cards equipped (Enemy Balance, Wave Accelerator) showed the same chances, spawn rate and speed.

notes: Health and attack are the panel's text: a mantissa cut (not rounded) to two decimals, and a suffix from 1,000 up.
attackSkips and healthSkips are the panel's Enemy Attack / Health Level Skip counters. The enemy level for a stat is the wave less that counter. They depend on the run, not on the wave.
eliteEach is the chance shown on each of the Vampire, Scatter and Ray rows.

bossHealth, bossSpeed, tankSpeed and protectorSpeed are recorded because the Boss row changes at wave 1500: its health goes from 20 times Basic to about 5.93 times, and its speed from the Protector's to the Tank's.
29 waves have no reading: a cell did not read, or (waves 1312, 1315, 1316, 1609, 1611) a skip counter was misread. The list is in missingWaves.
